claims: Prefer names that have NOT yet broken out over ones already extended.
Do not chase a stock that is already gapping up too much (GOOGL); if not in already, pass.
Trigger on a break of clearly marked prior resistance or yesterday's high; wedge breaks (lower highs / higher lows) are the core pattern.
Targets are the next prior support/resistance zone or gap above.
Take big profits on any push when the stock is in an overall downtrend.
Direction is conditional: long if index pushes through lower highs, short below a defined level.
Skip tickers that are gapping down with no structure.
vetoes: GOOGL — already gapping up too much, won't chase at open
NFLX — gapping down 4.3% on unclear news, no setup
